text.Advogado e mestre em Direito. Há quase u: Lawyer and Master of Laws (LL.M.). Nearly a decade spanning private practice and the public sector, including more than five years leading legal operations in the Judiciary. While leading a judge’s chambers, I ran legal operations at the point where they either hold or collapse: high volume.
text.<span aria-hidden=\"true\">— </span>Ante: — Before delegating the legal function, one must govern its reasoning.
text.Dois projetos, um arco narrativo e o que: Two projects, one narrative arc, and what runs through it.
text.<a class=\"b-data\" href=\"#data\" data-:

text.Cada projeto tem página própria. No arco: Each project has its own page. On the arc, click to open its panel.
text.O primeiro movimento ocorreu em gabinete: The first movement took place in first-instance chambers, facing a high-volume caseload with strong structural repetition. Before any method, the caseload had to become legible and the work measurable. I coordinated the intake of 36,000 tax enforcement cases that the Núcleo de Justiça 4.0 transferred to the court: triage, compliance checks and resuming each case from where it had stopped, without letting the portfolio pile up. Later, I trained a new chambers team in the same flow from scratch. Volume began to be read. That is where DATA would come from.
text.O segundo movimento amadureceu com a pas: The second movement matured with the shift from managing volume to conducting the decision flow. In 30 days, I developed ECHO, a Legal Ops methodology for operating appellate chambers: workflows, taxonomy, manuals. Predefined triage and routing for 1,192 cases. It ran for another 30 days. But it echoed: it was handed over to the chambers that succeeded us.
text.O terceiro movimento surgiu quando o rac: The third movement arose when reasoning, on meeting artificial intelligence, tried to accelerate ahead of method. In response, I designed ATRIO, a legal AI architecture: governance, audit, data protection. Implemented as the operation’s finalization rate rose by 16.18 pp in five months. AI does not replace the decision: it operates on a governed path.

text.Capacidade de interpretar informações, i: Ability to interpret information, identify patterns, and produce knowledge applicable to decision-making.
text.A operação mede volume, mas não consegue: The operation measures volume but cannot distinguish performance, capacity, progress, and the effects of interventions.
text.Reconstrução e análise de indicadores, d: Reconstruction and analysis of indicators, definition of populations, comparison of periods, robustness tests, and documentation of verifiable evidence.
text.A utilização operacional dos indicadores: The indicators were put to operational use in ECHO; DATA retrospectively systematizes their measurement and interpretive limits.
text.<b>pontos percentuais</b> na taxa de fin: percentage points in the finalization rate of the 2nd Appellate Panel team: from 44.21% (Dec 2025) to 60.39% (Apr 2026), over five full months. Temporal association, with no isolated causality.
text.<b>dias</b> de fila média até o voto: days of average queue time until the opinion
text.<b>dias</b> de fila média dos demais des: days of average queue time for other orders
Queue time is not working time.
text.A parcela de despachos convertidos em vo: The share of orders converted into opinions. An original indicator that, aligned with the CNJ’s KPI-based management (Ordinance No. 471/2025, art. 10, XI), measures the share of opinions in the total orders actually issued, distinguishing final output from intermediate output.
text.Cada número com rastro de onde vem e las: Every number with a trace of where it comes from and a grounding for what it allows us to claim.

text.Capacidade de estruturar processos, orga: Ability to structure processes, organize resources, and establish reproducible routines.
text.O conhecimento jurídico e operacional pe: Legal and operational knowledge remains scattered or depends on people’s memory, hindering its retrieval and transfer.
text.Captura de práticas, critérios e recorrê: Capture of practices, criteria, and recurring patterns, converted into manuals, records, and reusable repertoires for reference and knowledge transfer.
text.Etapas, responsabilidades e gargalos não: Steps, responsibilities, and bottlenecks are not organized into a common flow; execution depends on repeated instructions and improvised decisions.
text.Mapeamento da operação recursal, definiç: Mapping of the appellate operation, definition of roles, sequences, handoff criteria, and reusable procedures. PLAY embodies part of these instruments in an operational interface.
text.A informação existe, mas sua classificaç: The information exists, but its classification, location, and reuse are hindered by the lack of common structures and conventions.
text.Construção de taxonomias, hierarquias, c: Building of taxonomies, hierarchies, indexing criteria, and language standards, organizing the caseload and making information retrievable and consistent.
text.<b>de redução da complexidade de classif: reduction in classification complexity: 102 subjects consolidated into 10 categories, across three thematic clusters.
text.<b>modelos de ementa</b> catalogados no: headnote templates cataloged in the Headnote Index.
text.<b>Fundamentos.</b> Pesquisa de 107 fund: Legal Grounds. Search across 107 legal grounds by topic or trigger, with requirements and limits of application.
text.<b>Ementário.</b> Consulta a 2.758 regis: Headnote Index. Lookup of 2,758 records by subject, code, or base text.
text.<b>Calendário Jurídico.</b> Contagem de: Legal Calendar. Civil deadline counting in business days, with holidays, suspensions, and exclusions.
text.<b>Montador de Minutas.</b> Composição d: Draft Builder. Composition of opinions from six templates and conditional blocks.
text.<b>Busca Integrada.</b> Pesquisa transve: Integrated Search. Cross-search of documents, legal grounds, Headnote Index, and templates.

text.Capacidade de conceber e implementar sol: Ability to design and implement technical solutions to legal and operational problems, with a local API in Python (FastAPI) and PostgreSQL.
text.Documentos dispersos, duplicados ou não: Scattered, duplicated, or unstructured documents hinder the building of a reliable base for processing and use by AI.
text.Aquisição documental, integração por API: Document acquisition, API integration, incremental persistence, deduplication, normalization, and enrichment of legal information for governed use through CORPUS.
text.Componentes e etapas de produção jurídic: Components and stages of legal production can advance without common handoff criteria, defined controls, or human validation.
text.Integração modular por regras executávei: Modular integration through executable rules, a state machine, phased decision paths, and blocking controls at critical transitions, preserving the operator’s accountability.
text.Formulações aparentemente consistentes p: Seemingly consistent formulations can hide weaknesses that a confirmation-oriented review fails to identify.
text.O CERNE submete dúvidas jurídicas ao con: CERNE subjects legal doubts to confrontation by independent arguments, with structured evaluation criteria, questions linked to the passages analyzed, and a record of dismissed doubts.
text.Consolida 2 mecanismos | CORPUS / RATIO: Consolidates 2 mechanisms | CORPUS / RATIO / CERNE / LUX
text.Dados pessoais podem circular sem proteç: Personal data may circulate without adequate protection, while sources, transformations, and interventions can no longer be reconstructed.
text.Proteção de informações na entrada e na: Protection of information at input and output, controlled pseudonymization, and preservation of the records needed to reconstruct the documentary and decision path.
text.O refinamento de um texto pode introduzi: Refining a text can introduce undue changes to previously validated legal content.
text.Aplicação de regras de linguagem, estrut: Application of language rules, structure, and intervention limits, distinguishing formal refinement from any silent change to the merits.
